customManagers.description: squawk, pinned in the migration-lint action's install script by the marker comment above its version
firebase-tools, pinned exact in android-deploy.yml behind a renovate marker. The shared preset enables no manager for _VERSION markers, so this one reads that single file
The react-doctor version the action and its workflow default to, read from the trailing renovate marker on each default
The osv-scanner, syft and cdxgen versions actions/dependency-check and actions/sbom install: a renovate marker comment, then the pinned version on the next line

packageRules.description: A bump to a lint tool in mise.toml or hk.pkl changes nothing callers run, so it must not cut a release

Each of these is what a shared workflow or action runs for callers (migration-lint, the deploy workflow, the react-doctor scan, dependency-check, sbom), so a bump releases like any chore(deps), unlike the other custom.regex pins
android-deploy.yml pins this action to a commit SHA because it runs with the signing key's service-account token, so a bump is read by a person and never merged unattended
